name: Maynooth University
summary: Campus university in the town of Maynooth, west of Dublin; broad Arts and Science degrees let you start with several subjects and narrow down later.

ib.text: Six subjects with English; Arts and Music add a third language, Business and Science Maths (SL 5 or HL 3). Strictest: Engineering HL Maths 5 plus a science; Music a video audition at grade 6 standard.

dates.label: BMus Bachelor of Music (MH103, restricted): must be on your CAO list

programmes.name: Bachelor of Music
programmes.about: Performance, composition and academic study together, from Irish traditional music and plainchant to popular music and musical theatre, with individual tuition, ensembles and a major in performance, composition or musicology in the final year.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English and a third language; a video audition at Grade 6 standard is required.

needs.note: A third language besides English and Irish

programmes.selectionNote: Restricted course: list it on CAO by 1 February and pass an online video audition at Grade 6 standard; CAO points are not used. Irish is waived if you were not schooled in Ireland.

flagshipSource.title: Maynooth Music: performance, composition and musicology, individual tuition and an entrance scholarship for MH103

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Electronic Engineering)
programmes.about: Electronic engineering with problem-based learning projects every year, accredited by Engineers Ireland, and an optional ME stream in fourth year with six months of industry work, Erasmus or a research internship.
programmes.ib: HL Maths 5, SL 4 in English and a science or technology subject, and HL 5 in two subjects in all.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points. Irish is part of the Leaving Certificate rule but is waived if you were not schooled in Ireland.

flagshipSource.title: Maynooth Electronic Engineering: accredited by Engineers Ireland, problem-based projects each year

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: Start with four subjects from eight, Mathematics among them, across Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematical Physics and more, then narrow to a specialised degree in later years.
programmes.ib: Maths SL 5 or HL 3 and a lab science at SL 4, with HL 5 in two subjects in all.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points. Some later specialisations need 60% in first-year subjects and have limited transfer places.

flagshipSource.title: Maynooth Science: choose four subjects in first year, with Maths and Computer Science support centres

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Humanities
faculties.line: Arts (over 30 subjects) needs English and a third language, plus 2 HL 5 and 4 more passes; Music and Education Studies add steps.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Science needs Maths and a lab science; Engineering needs HL Maths 5; the new Computer Science and AI degree starts in 2027.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: Social Science (double major with Social Policy) needs English and a third language; the Community and Youth Work degree is restricted.

notes: Irish is part of the NUI entry rule, but if you were not born or schooled in Ireland you qualify for an exemption, and Maynooth says only applicants from the Republic need to apply for one.
Music (MH103) and Community and Youth Work (MH116) are restricted: list them by 1 February (or add them by 1 March), never in Change of Mind.
New for 2027: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence (MH605) and Arts with Education Studies (MH102).
